title: sre-weekly-ops-sync-prep-2026-04-02
content:
Purpose:
Prep notes for SRE weekly ops sync + reliability review (2026-04-02). Bring current SLO status, paging trends, top incidents, and proposed mitigations.

Quick summary:
- Availability SLOs currently healthy but error budget consumption trending up for model-serving frontends (last 7d: 6.4% error budget used on availability SLO for hosted-api-us-west).
- Latency SLO for tail latency (p95) has one regression tied to a regressing kernel in the new quantized runtime (investigating).
- Paging trend: avg pages/day increased to 4.1 from baseline 1.8 — most pages from autoscaler flaps and pod OOMs on dedicated pools.
- Top incidents last week: REL-1239 (KV cache invalidation after rollout), REL-1240 (autoscaler race causing transient 503s), REL-1243 (misconfigured probe causing restart loop on canary).

SLOs / metrics to bring to meeting:
- Availability SLOs: Hosted API (global): target 99.95% - current 99.96% (30d), last 7d 99.92% — note spike on 2026-03-30 related to REL-1240.
- Dedicated pool SLO: throughput SLO currently meeting target, but tail latency p95 increased from 180ms -> 320ms in last 72h for long-context traffic.
- Latency SLO (p95 text-gen): target 350ms - current 370ms (last 7d). Flag: p99 also rising (700ms -> 1.1s).
- Error budget burn: Hosted-api-us-west availability: 6.4% consumed (7d). If continued, will require mitigation/communication in 2w.

Paging trends (last 14 days):
- Avg pages/day: 4.1 (prev baseline 1.8).
- Page sources: autoscaler flaps (35%), pod OOMs on dedicated pools (25%), KV cache issues (20%), infra/network (10%), other (10%).
- On-call feedback: noise from autoscaler flaps correlated with recent node image roll and aggressive scaling policy in dedicated pools. Need to relax scale-down thresholds for the burst window.

Top incidents (high level):
1) REL-1240 - autoscaler race -> transient 503s (2026-03-30)
   - Impact: brief 5-12m window of 503s for a subset of hosted-api requests region us-west.
   - Root cause (current understanding): race between scale-to-zero and scale-up path; controller raced with new node provisioning.
   - Mitigation applied: reverted aggressive scale-down policy; added short-term fixed replica floor (2) for critical routes.
   - Action items: engineering to add coordination lock to autoscaler controller (owner: Alex Martin, due: 2026-04-09).

2) REL-1239 - KV cache invalidation after rollout (2026-03-28)
   - Impact: higher latency and increased token compute due to cache misses across dedicated pools.
   - Root cause: rollout triggered cache key format change without coordinated warm-up.
   - Mitigation: rolled back rollout and re-ran warm-up job.
   - Action items: add merge-gate checklist for cache format changes and automated warm-up (owner: Samira Patel, due: 2026-04-16).

3) REL-1243 - misconfigured readiness probe on canary (2026-03-31)
   - Impact: restart loop on 10% canary, causing extra retries and transient 500s for routed traffic.
   - Mitigation: fixed probe config and re-deployed canary.
   - Action items: add probe/healthcheck linting to CI (owner: Jordan Lee, due: 2026-04-10).

Agenda for sync (30-40m):
- Quick SLO review (5m) - Jordan
- Paging trends and immediate mitigations (7m) - Samira
- Incident review: REL-1240 & REL-1239 root cause and actions (10m) - Alex + eng leads
- Long-tail latency discussion and proposed mitigations (8m) - perf team representative
- Action item review and owners (5m) - Jordan

Proposed mitigations / proposals to discuss:
- Autoscaler: add coordination lock + increase scale-down buffer window and add temporary replica floor for high-priority routes.
- KV cache: implement a backwards-compatible key versioning scheme and automated warm-up job as part of any rollout that touches cache keys.
- Latency: roll back the latest quantized kernel rollout on canary and run microbenchmarks; add p99 alerting with adjustable thresholds to detect tail regressions earlier.

Open questions / notes to follow up on:
- Does dedupe of warm-up jobs across clusters make sense (cost vs benefit)?
- Can the platform team expose an "is-canary" header to improve routing away from canaries during sensitivity windows?
- Need clarity on SLA communication plan if error budget burn continues for hosted-api-us-west. Who owns external comms? (suggest product/ops + CS).

Action items (current):
- Alex Martin: design + PR for autoscaler coordination lock. Due 2026-04-09.
- Samira Patel: cache-format merge-gate and warm-up automation spec. Due 2026-04-16.
- Jordan Lee: add probe/healthcheck linting to CI + PR. Due 2026-04-10.
- Product (assign): draft comms plan for customers if availability continues to degrade (owner: TBD, 2026-04-13).
- On-call rotation: consider adding an infra-focused secondary for next 2 weeks while we stabilize autoscaler. (owner: on-call lead)

Notes to self:
- Pull detailed metrics dashboard for p95/p99 latency vs kernel version and quantization flag before meeting.
- Bring sample logs for REL-1240 race window (timestamps: 2026-03-30 21:15-21:30 UTC).
- Confirm that the warm-up job telemetry includes hit-rate after rollout (we need 3 datapoints post-warm-up).

Appendix (quick links):
- Incident pages: https://confluence.redwood.ai/REL-1239 https://confluence.redwood.ai/REL-1240 https://confluence.redwood.ai/REL-1243
- SLO dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/SLOs/sre-overview
- Autoscaler controller repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler

End of prep notes.
